t: Taking The NixOS Wayland Hyprland Plunge!
s: This article details an experiment migrating from GNOME to Hyprland on NixOS, exploring its customizability and speed against GNOME's integrated experience. Despite appreciating Hyprland's responsiveness, the author ultimately preferred GNOME for its polished workflow and efficient workspace management.
sub: NixOS Hyprland configuration challenges with Nvidia and Electron apps
Comparison of Hyprland's modularity versus GNOME's integrated desktop experience
Window management philosophy: tiling vs. overlapping windows and the role of virtual desktops
Technical considerations for Wayland, Nvidia, and Electron app compatibility
